name: Recode Studios Ltd
title: Recode Studios Ltd - 544755 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: H1 FY27 revenue +24% and EBITDA only +8.75% to 6.45 crore as margins fell to ~14%; management still guides ~50% FY27 growth and 23-25% H2 margin, but gives no numbers for Q3 and is evasive on receivables and advances.

summary.headline: H1 FY27 revenue rose 24.04% to ₹45.82 crore, EBITDA up 8.75% to ₹6.45 crore, with management guiding ~50% FY27 growth and ~25% blended EBITDA margin.
summary.overview: Recode Studios reported H1 FY27 revenue of ₹45.82 crore (+24.04%), EBITDA of about ₹6.45 crore (+8.75%) and PAT of ₹4.92 crore (+26.77%). Management said revenue and operating margins were below internal expectations, attributing this to front-loaded hiring, new verticals launched in a weak season, and quick-commerce and organised retail build-out. Management maintained a ~50% FY27 growth target and a blended EBITDA margin near 25% for the full year, and said October-November demand was strong, though the call contained no hard figures for the current quarter.

financial_highlights.change: Versus ~23% in H2 of prior year (analyst's figure)

financial_highlights.value: ~₹3.5 crore (analyst's figure); ₹3.64 crore cash in hand from IPO proceeds

segments.name: Color cosmetics (core brand Recode)
segments.commentary: Portfolio expanded from ~350 to ~400 SKUs, with ~100 more planned in H2 to reach ~500. Nykaa touchpoints increased to 34; 60-minute delivery via Nykaa Now live in 7 cities.

segments.name: Aflairza (acquisition)
segments.commentary: Stake currently ~33%, to be raised to 51% in January 2027. Management guides Aflairza to ~₹20 crore revenue (about 2x) and ~₹3-3.5 crore PAT for FY27; Recode's 51% share implies ~₹1.5-2 crore PAT.

segments.name: Frisa (strategic investment)
segments.commentary: Management cited the investment as strengthening presence in premium and luxury color cosmetics; no financials were disclosed. The transcript rendering of the name is uncertain.

guidance_outlook: FY27 revenue growth of at least 50% reiterated; analyst-cited target of ~₹75 crore top line, and management referenced a ₹120 crore target for the year.
Blended EBITDA margin expected to recover to closer to 25% for FY27; in a later answer, management said FY27 PAT and EBITDA would be broadly in line with the prior year, within 1-2 points either way.
H2 margin expected at roughly 23-25% per analyst's framing; management said H2 could be 1-2 points below last year but would not decline drastically.
Management expects H2 revenue to be at least 2x H1, citing the wedding season running from 20 November to July.
FY28 growth aspiration not quantified; management said it will be clearer in January.
Management will not hire further beyond 5-10 front-line staff; employee expenses are targeted at 5-7% of revenue.
capex_capacity: Asset-light model: no in-house manufacturing, and management does not intend to manufacture.
Dark-store network expanding: new dark store in Jammu in 5-10 days; Odisha dark store live; stores opened in Jabalpur, Patna and Ranchi.
Dark stores are used to build markets before opening FOFO stores; all 100 planned new stores are to be FOFO, per management.
Closed one COCO store in Mumbai for weak profit and visibility; management said store closures should not exceed 10% of openings.
IPO proceeds: management said the working-capital allocation was used as stated in the report; ~₹3.64 crore remains in hand.
demand_pricing: Management described sales up to Diwali as record-breaking, with a slowdown after Diwali that has since recovered over the last 3 days, across own website, Nykaa, Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra and offline.
Expansion into Tier 2-4 cities and South India (Chennai, Coimbatore, Hyderabad, Maharashtra districts) is underway.
Customer acquisition: CAC stated as ~20% of revenue collectively; website AOV ~₹900; repeat customers ~40% month-on-month; Meta ads account for ~99.5% of ad spend.
Marketing spend stated at ~20% of revenue, versus ~50% for Renee and Sugar Cosmetics per management.
Management said the working-capital cycle has stretched to its limit; advances to suppliers, with interest at 12%, were ₹8-9 crore added to short-term loans and advances.
Management said H1 was the investment phase; H2 includes the wedding season (20 November to July).

qa_highlights.question: Is the 50% growth guidance intact, and what is the Q3/festive-season read?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said 50% growth is still the target and is on track; H1 was ~25%. Sales up to Diwali were record-breaking, with a short post-Diwali dip. No Q3 growth number was given.

qa_highlights.question: Why did margins decline in H1, and will H2 recover?
qa_highlights.answer: Management cited hiring ahead of the season, quick-commerce kiosks and the broader new-vertical push. Management said H2 is when H1 investments pay back, and that margin may be 1-2 points below last year but will not decline drastically.

qa_highlights.question: What is the Aflairza plan and FY27 guidance?
qa_highlights.answer: Aflairza is to stay an independent brand for 2-3 years, with the promoters running it (51% Recode, 49% promoters). FY27 target: ~₹20 crore revenue and ~₹3-3.5 crore PAT (100% basis).

qa_highlights.question: Will the 100 new stores be FOFO or COCO, and what is the closure ratio?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said all new stores will be FOFO and closures should not exceed 10% of openings. Management also stated the company does not focus on operations.

qa_highlights.question: What is the employee count and further hiring plan?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said ~65-75 employees were hired post-IPO, with 5-10 more front-line hires planned; ~90% of the hiring is complete. Employee expenses are targeted at 5-7% of revenue.

qa_highlights.question: Where is the working capital cycle and receivables heading?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said receivables have improved and the cycle has already stretched as far as intended, with no further stretch planned. Supplier advances are for sourcing; the split between India and imports was not provided.

qa_highlights.question: What was the use of IPO proceeds?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said some proceeds were used and ~₹3.64 crore is in hand; the working-capital portion was used as stated in the report.

risks_watch: H1 revenue growth of 24% versus the ~50% full-year target; H2 needs to be at least ~2x H1 to deliver guidance.
EBITDA margin likely below the ~25% target if H2 slows; H1 operating margin ~14% per analyst, with H2 recovery to 23-25% needed.
Employee cost step-up after IPO and a dependence on the wedding season; management cited the US-Iran conflict and lower disposable income as headwinds.
Rising trade receivables and ₹8-9 crore added short-term loans/advances to suppliers, with unclear inter-party nature; management could not give the import/domestic sourcing split.
Management did not disclose SKU-level or geographic revenue data, nor the import share of the portfolio.
Key-person dependence on the Chairman and MD; management gave limited quantified guidance beyond FY27.
summary.management_tone: Confident and assertive on the long-term growth story and H2 season, but defensive and evasive on specifics: repeatedly declined to give Q3 growth, current-quarter numbers, FY28 targets and sourcing split, deferring to January. Acknowledged H1 underperformed internal expectations.
key_quotes: While we have delivered growth across key financial parameters, both revenue and operating margins remained below our internal expectations.
we remain confident of recovering our EBITDA margin closer to 25% on a blended basis for the full financial year 2027.
I will not surprise the market by allowing EBITDA to disappear.
H1 is always very poor for color cosmetics because of humid weather, summer, and rain.
I follow an asset-light model. I do not manufacture anything, and I do not intend to manufacture anything in the future.

adds.what: New dark store in Jammu (opening in 5-10 days)
100 planned new FOFO stores (to be opened over time, dark stores used to build markets first)

growth.why: Management reiterated at least 50% FY27 revenue growth, with H2 expected at least 2x H1 on the wedding season, backed by a 100-store FOFO plan, a Jammu dark store opening in 5-10 days, and Aflairza revenue guided to about ₹20 crore; but no hard current-quarter figures were given and H1 EBITDA growth (+8.75%) and margin (~14%) lag the guidance.

quality.why: H1 FY27 revenue rose 24.04% to ₹45.82 crore, but the brief gives no split of volume, price or mix and no one-off items; the Aflairza stake is only ~33% and not yet consolidated as a driver, and the record festive-season sales are qualitative with no Q2 figure.

rows.label: Margin expansion
rows.why: H1 EBITDA up only 8.75% on 24% revenue growth with margin near 14% (analyst figure) versus ~23% in H2 last year; management guides H2 margin 1-2 points below last year, not a drastic decline, and blended ~25% for FY27 is hard to reconcile with that H1 base.

rows.label: Capacity expansion / commissioning
rows.why: 100 new FOFO stores planned (to be opened over time), a Jammu dark store opening in 5-10 days and Odisha dark store live, with ~100 more SKUs planned in H2; no capacity or plant metrics were given.

rows.label: Volume growth
rows.why: Management guides H2 revenue at least 2x H1 (H1 ₹45.82 crore, +24%) on the wedding season, reiterates at least 50% FY27 growth, and cites record sales up to Diwali, though no Q3 figure was given.

rows.label: New capex announcement
rows.why: Asset-light model with no in-house manufacturing, and no capex figure was disclosed; capacity build is via dark stores and FOFO stores rather than a capex programme.

rows.label: Guidance upgrade
rows.why: Management held the ≥50% growth target but H1 revenue grew 24% and EBITDA only 8.75%, so there is no sign of an upward revision.

rows.label: Guidance downgrade
rows.why: H2 must be at least 2x H1 to hit ~50% growth, H1 underperformed internal expectations, and the stated ~25% blended margin needs H2 at 23-25% against ~14% in H1; management also cited the US-Iran conflict and weaker disposable income.

rows.label: New product launch
rows.why: Colour cosmetics SKUs rise from ~400 to ~500 with ~100 more planned in H2, and Nykaa Now 60-minute delivery is live in 7 cities.

rows.label: Aflairza stake raised from ~33% to 51%
rows.why: Management plans the step-up in January 2027; Recode's 51% share implies ~₹1.5-2 crore PAT on Aflairza's ₹3-3.5 crore FY27 PAT target (100% basis).

rows.label: Supplier advances and receivables strain
rows.why: ₹8-9 crore added to short-term loans and advances at 12% interest, with management saying the working-capital cycle has stretched to its limit and cash in hand is about ₹3.64 crore.

rows.label: Tier 2-4 cities and South India expansion
rows.why: Expansion into Chennai, Coimbatore, Hyderabad and Maharashtra districts is underway, alongside new dark stores in Jabalpur, Patna, Ranchi and Jammu.

tone.note: Management was confident about the 50% FY27 growth target, the H2 wedding season and the FOFO store plan, but was defensive and evasive on Q3 numbers, FY28 targets, the sourcing split and the working-capital loans; analysts pushed on the H1 margin drop to ~14% and whether H2 can reach 23-25%.
